text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that does not involve land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. Instead, it focuses on optimizing the spatial allocation of agricultural intensity—defined via input cost per hectare—to explore trade-offs between food production and farmland bird biodiversity. While the study is spatially explicit at the national scale (France) and uses multiple scenarios (intensification, extensification, reallocation), it does not model or predict future LULC changes. Land use types (e.g., cropland vs. grassland) are treated as static background conditions; the analysis varies only intensity within existing land uses. Thus, it fails the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus must be LULC prediction. Additionally, it meets an exclusion criterion: “Species-specific/ecological focus (flora/fauna) unrelated to LULC”—here, farmland bird community composition is a central biodiversity metric, and LULC change is not modeled.)
